rules: INSPIRE is updated on the first Sunday of each month and represents data from the previous month
each INSPIRE polygon has a unique Land Registry-INSPIRE ID related to a registered title
one registered title can contain several separate polygons
each separate polygon can have its own Land Registry-INSPIRE ID
absence of an INSPIRE ID can mean unregistered land or a leasehold or other tenure not present in public INSPIRE
INSPIRE polygons show indicative position and extent and do not establish legal title extent
legal extent requires the individual title plan rather than INSPIRE alone
Find a Property supports search using a Land Registry-INSPIRE ID
INSPIRE data and attributes are reusable under the Open Government Licence
reuse requires HM Land Registry source attribution
reuse of polygon geometry also requires Ordnance Survey attribution
current HM Land Registry INSPIRE conditions use Ordnance Survey attribution identifier AC0000851063
HM Land Registry GML polygon coordinates are captured against British National Grid
HM Land Registry warns BNG to WGS84 reprojection may shift some features by up to 15 metres
current 5 July 2026 download listing includes both London Borough of Barnet and London Borough of Enfield as GML authorities
current title-boundary dataset reports 2792111 title boundaries
current title-boundary dataset reports one data provider
collector last ran on 2026-07-26
new title-boundary data was last found on 2026-07-23
dataset origin notes some MHCLG-created data is being replaced with authoritative sources
title-boundary dataset is licensed under OGL v3.0
title-boundary information carries HM Land Registry copyright and database-right attribution
title-boundary polygon geometry carries Ordnance Survey copyright and database-right attribution 100026316
recent title-boundary entities have entry-date 2026-07-23
recent title-boundary entities can carry quality=authoritative
recent authoritative title-boundary entities identify HM Land Registry as organisation
title-boundary entity geometry is exposed as WKT MULTIPOLYGON
title-boundary entity point is exposed as WKT POINT
LIDAR Composite DTM 1m covers approximately 99 percent of England
LIDAR Composite DTM primary spatial resolution is 1 metre
DTM is produced from the last or only laser pulse returned to the sensor
surface objects are removed from DSM to produce terrain-only DTM
2022 composite merges Time Stamped archive and National LIDAR Programme surveys
where repeat surveys exist the newest best-resolution data is used
bilinear interpolation is used where source data is resampled
composite survey period begins 2000-06-06
composite survey period ends 2022-04-02
metadata index catalogues identify which survey contributes at a location
1m DTM downloads are GeoTIFF rasters in 5km tiles aligned to the OS National Grid
elevation values are presented in metres
vertical reference is Ordnance Survey Newlyn
OSTN15 transformation method is used
individual contributing LIDAR surveys have vertical accuracy plus or minus 15cm RMSE and CRS EPSG:27700
OS Terrain 50 is an open Digital Terrain Model product for Great Britain
OS Terrain 50 is updated annually in July
grid and contour products are created from the same source data
Terrain50 is supplied as 10km by 10km tiles identified by the National Grid reference of the south-west corner
Terrain50 grid has regular 50m post spacing
Terrain50 online download is available with no registration required
the full ASCII GML and shapefile supply contains 2858 tiles arranged in 55 100km-grid folders
ASCII grid rows contain 200 pixels
each ASCII grid pixel is 50m by 50m
each ASCII height is calculated from the centre of its pixel
ASCII map-header origin is the north-west corner of the tile
height values are given to the nearest 0.1m
per-tile metadata identifies British National Grid EPSG:27700 and Ordnance Datum Newlyn EPSG:5701
per-tile metadata separates earliest/latest flying dates from processing date and version/lineage
OS OpenData API routes require no API key while Premium data-package routes require API-key or OAuth authentication
